annotations.title: imagepeek: convert an image to another format

description: imagepeek: Convert an image to PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO or AVIF. To shrink the file use image_compress. Returns the image converted `to` png, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff, bmp, ico (16-256 px icon sizes) or avif, with `quality`, progressive JPEG, optimized PNG or lossless WebP; transparency is flattened onto `background` (default white) for jpeg and bmp. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-convert-api.html

auto_orient.description: Apply the EXIF orientation first (default true).
auto_orient.title: Auto Orient

background.description: Alpha is flattened onto this for jpeg/bmp (#ffffff).
background.title: Background

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 for lossy formats (default: per format).
quality.title: Quality

to.description: png, jpeg, webp, gif, tiff, bmp, ico or avif.
to.title: To

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url
